name: Washington FFA Association
what_you_do: FFA is a student group tied to your school's farm and food class. Members build leadership and job skills at workshops, conferences and career events.
who_can_apply: Students enrolled in agricultural education at a school with an FFA chapter. The page does not give age or grade limits.
pay_detail: Not stated on the program pages. Ask your ag teacher about dues.
deadline_text: Join through your school's agriculture program.
how_to_apply: Ask your school's ag teacher if your school has an FFA chapter and how to join.
notes: The page says the association has over 14,500 members in 194 chapters. Dues are $7 a year nationally and $10 a year for Washington. Local chapters may charge more.
